name: Felyne Hope Helm
description:
A helm made for the expedition.
A fusion of traditional Palico
techniques and new technology.

name: Felyne Hope Suit
description:
Armor made for the expedition.
Enough pockets to carry a shop-
full of support items!

name: Felyne Bone Helm
description:
Headgear built around a monster
skull base. Donning it will awaken
the primal beast within.

name: Felyne Bone Mail
description:
A primal musk clings to this set
of body armor. Crafted from
an array of monster bones.

name: F Cabra Hood
description:
The opening of this Chatacabra
hood is pulled extra snug to keep
stray sand from getting inside.

name: Felyne Cabra Jumpsuit
description:
Designed with mobility in mind,
this Chatacabra one-piece is as
comfy as it is safe.

name: Felyne Quema Helm
description:
The flaming red plumes on the
crest of this Quematrice helm
sets a Palico's heart ablaze.

name: Felyne Quema Mail
description:
The frilly hem and large train
on this Quematrice mail make
a Palico feel like they're flying.

name: Felyne Alloy Helm
description:
A helmet made by smelting fine
ore, then pounding it for three
days straight. Certified strong.

name: Felyne Alloy Mail
description:
Body armor made by smelting fine
ore, then pounding it for three
days straight. Guaranteed tough.

name: Felyne Barina Wig
description:
A wig made of Lala Barina hairs,
brushed until properly coifed for
max defense then styled to slay.

name: Felyne Barina Dress
description:
This meticulously crafted Lala
Barina armor's rose motif turns
any Palico into a prima donna.

name: Felyne Conga Head
description:
A pointed hat whose proud, pink
puff makes a Palico feel pretty
darned special.

name: Felyne Conga Fete
description:
Mirthful cymbals that say, "Here
I come!" as a Palico marches to
the battlefield.

name: Felyne Balahara Helm
description:
This Balahara helmet is stuffed
to the gills with cutting-edge
sensor technology.

name: Felyne Balahara Mech
description:
A stunning amalgam of the latest
tech, this Balahara mech is the
final word in Felyne warfare.

name: F Doshaguma Helm
description:
The wild hair bursting from
this Doshaguma helm is for
intimidation. The little braids
are for cuteness.

name: F Doshaguma Mail
description:
The restraints comprising this
Doshaguma mail are fearsome,
but a bit tough to move in...

name: Felyne Duna Mask
description:
It is said that those who don
this Uth Duna mask are able
to commune with the forest.

name: Felyne Duna Cape
description:
Surprisingly breathable, this
Uth Duna armor allows the 
wearer to feel the forest's
respiration.

name: F Rompopolo Brain
description:
This Rompopolo headgear may
LOOK like a brain floating in a jar,
but... best not to think about it.

name: F Rompopolo Suit
description:
The wearer is immune to the
Rompopolo poison pumped
through this suit. Those around
it, though...

name: Felyne Dau Helm
description:
Headgear forged of Rey Dau
parts. No earthly force can
bow the head crowned by the
golden sun.

name: Felyne Dau Armor
description:
Those who clad themselves
in Rey Dau's fearsome visage
gain its majesty and might
as well.

name: Felyne Scylla Mask
description:
A mask that covers the head.
The opaque goggles are too
cool for Palico school.

name: Felyne Scylla Mail
description:
A suit that covers the body.
Painstakingly crafted, it
exudes bewitching beauty.

name: Felyne Hirabami Cap
description:
The oversized ribbon accent
adds charm to this braided
leather headgear made of
Hirabami parts.

name: Felyne Hirabami Robe
description:
A robe fit for a sage from a
faraway land. The long, billowy
sleeves are both elegant and
adorable.

name: F Ajarakan Helm
description:
An Ajarakan helm said to emit
a mighty shriek that has the
power to repel all evil.

name: F Ajarakan Mail
description:
This Ajarakan armor grants the
wearer evil-banishing powers.
Also, a rockin' bod. Me-ow!

name: Felyne Udra Head
description:
Those who don this Nu Udra
helm are shown a world
crawling with aberrations
that defy description.

name: Felyne Udra Tentacles
description:
This Nu Udra armor's tentacles
writhe and grasp at prey
entirely of their own will.

name: F Guardian Dosha Helm
description:
A helm made of Guardian
Doshaguma materials. Something
tugs at the wearer. "I was meant
to be more than a Palico..."

name: F Guardian Dosha Mail
description:
The bleached-white portions of
this Guardian Doshaguma armor
glow faintly, and are warm to
the touch.

name: F Guardian Rath Helm
description:
A helm made of Guardian
Rathalos materials. Something
tugs at the wearer. "I was meant
to be more than a Palico..."

name: F Guardian Rath Mail
description:
The bleached-white portions of
this Guardian Rathalos armor
glow faintly, and are warm to
the touch.

name: F Guardian Ebony Helm
description:
A helm made of Guardian Ebony
Odogaron materials. Something
tugs at the wearer. "I was meant
to be more than a Palico..."

name: F Guardian Ebony Mail
description:
The bleached-white portions of
this Guardian Ebony Odogaron
armor glow faintly, and are warm
to the touch.

name: Felyne Xu Wu Veil
description:
This veil of Xu Wu materials
grants the wearer eyes that
peer into both past and future.

name: Felyne Xu Wu Suit
description:
Those who don this Xu Wu armor
will always find the true path,
even in the darkest night.

name: F Guardian Ark Helm
description:
Any who wear this Guardian
Arkveld helm are guided by
a formless, relentless hand
to press onward.

name: F Guardian Ark Mail
description:
Palicoes clad in this Guardian
Arkveld armor cease to feel any
trace of exhaustion or fatigue...
they think.

name: Athos's Scar α
description:
A stick-on scar to match Athos,
Astrum Unit's elite Palico.
I'm not asking her how she 
got it. <ITALIC>You</ITALIC> ask her...

name: Athos's Armor α
description:
Knightly mail to match Athos,
Astrum Unit's elite Palico.
The striking fur cape is fit for
nobility.

description:

description:

name: Felyne Blango Head α
description:
Pop this Blangonga headgear
on, and your "meows"
will all come out as
"oo-oo ah-ahs"!

name: Felyne Blango Body α
description:
This fluffy Blangonga armor is
heaven to wear, but it makes
your legs look a bit stubby...

name: Felyne Rathalos Helm α
description:
Head armor as wild and regal
as the King of the Skies.
Quiets the fiercest of fires.

name: Felyne Rathalos Mail α
description:
Body armor made of the King
of the Skies' carapace, as strong
and regal as its namesake.

name: Felyne Grav Mask α
description:
The dim glow of magma shines
out from the interior of this
gloomy Gravios headwear.

name: Felyne Grav Armor α
description:
Gravios armor with pauldrons
strong enough to easily
shoulder any threat.

name: Felyne Dahaad Corona α
description:
Regal Jin Dahaad headgear
modeled after the crown worn
by a queen who presided over
a thousand-year peace.

name: Felyne Dahaad Gown α
description:
An elegant Jin Dahaad dress
that embodies the glory and
grace of a queen.

description:

gain its majesty and might

name: Felyne Gore Horror α
description:
The flames of despair find a
home in the gaze of any who
dare don this Gore Magala
helm.

name: Felyne Gore Ghost α
description:
This Gore Magala armor brings
its wearer absolute victory...
and assured doom.

name: F Guardian Ark Helm α
description:
Any who wear this Guardian
Arkveld helm are guided by
a formless, relentless hand
to press onward.

name: F Guardian Ark Mail α
description:
Palicoes clad in this Guardian
Arkveld armor cease to feel any
trace of exhaustion or fatigue...
they think.

name: Felyne Arkveld Helm α
description:
An Arkveld helmet modeled after
that of a squire who served
the knight of a fallen kingdom.

name: Felyne Arkveld Mail α
description:
Arkveld mail modeled after
a squire said to have faithfully
served their master until the
very end.

name: Felyne Deathgear Hood α
description:
This deathly hood would scare
the pants right off of your Palico.
If they actually wore pants.

name: Felyne Deathgear Cowl α
description:
A spooky black shroud. Possibly
cursed. The wearer experiences
constant chills up their spine.

name: Felyne Hymstrigian Hood α
description:
Head armor modeled after a
plush Hymstrigian. Wear it
to gain a beautiful singing
voice (yeah right.)

name: Felyne Hymstrigian Coat α
description:
Body armor modeled after a
plush Hymstrigian. Compels
wearers to sing along with
Amstrigian.

name: Felyne Kunafa Hood α
description:
Felyne fashion from Kunafa that
offers cover from the sun and
wind. It even turns into a picnic
blanket come break time!

name: Felyne Kunafa Suit α
description:
Woven in a style unique to
Kunafa. Blocks out heat and
locks in moisture—a perfect
choice for desert travel.

name: Wudwud Mask α
description:
A convincing Wudwud costume.
"Same lookings! Big same!
Nice-nice. Good-good!"
<COLOR preset="I_YELLOW">(Full Armor Set)</COLOR>

name: Wudwud Body α
description:
A convincing Wudwud costume.
"Fluffsome. Fuzzly. A feel
most splendiferous."
<COLOR preset="I_YELLOW">(Full Armor Set)</COLOR>

name: Felyne Azuz Head α
description:
A...helmet(?) unearthed in the
Oilwell Basin. Any who put it on
report strange and unintelligible
mutterings filling their mind.

name: Felyne Azuz Body α
description:
Some...armor(?) unearthed in
the Oilwell Basin. Those who don
it report their body suddenly
moving against their will.

name: Felyne Suja Frog α
description:
An amphibious pal scooped up in
the Peaks of Accord. Giving it a
ride on your noggin grants good
luck. Today will be a nice day!

name: Felyne Suja Vest α
description:
This Felyne garb from the Peaks
of Accord looks lightweight, but
was woven with protective sigils
passed down from ancient times.

name: Felyne Sild Hood α
description:
Head protection from the 
Keepers' village that is
historically worn only when
carrying out dangerous work.

name: Felyne Sild Suit α
description:
This protective wear from the
Keepers' village is so comfy,
many Palicoes have taken to
wearing it around the house.

name: Felyne Artian Core α
description:
A highly sturdy Palico helm
made from a mysterious
mined metal.

name: Felyne Artian Gear α
description:
The materials in this suit
inexplicably magnetize,
keeping Palicoes afloat.

name: Felyne Leather Cap
description:
Standard-issue headgear for
Palicoes who once explored the
New World. Light but fairly tough.

name: Felyne Leather Vest
description:
This armor gives Palicoes that
have once traveled the New
World full freedom of motion.

name: Felyne Duffel Hood
description:
Headgear for Palicoes that braved
the icy Hinterlands. The hood
comfily covers the ears.

name: Felyne Duffel Coat
description:
Armor worn by Palicoes that 
braved the icy Hinterlands. 
Keep warm in even the coldest
of locales!

name: F Mizutsune Kasa α
description:
Headgear made from Mizutsune
materials. The distinct conical
hat and fetching mask make
this a hit at festivals.

name: F Mizutsune Suit α
description:
Armor made from Mizutsune
materials. This traditional Eastern
garb is so tricky it takes two sets
of paws to put on.

name: F Numinous Crown α
description:
Head armor imbued with
Zoh Shia's soul. Its innocent
smile twists in response
to its wearer's despair.

name: F Numinous Robe α
description:
Body armor imbued with Zoh
Shia's soul. The wings twitch
ominously in response to the
wearer's cravings.

name: Felyne Lagia Tricorne α
description:
A pirate hat made from
Lagiacrus parts. It unleashes
a Palico's inner buccaneer.

name: Felyne Lagia Mail α
description:
Armor made from Lagiacrus
parts. It brings out a Palico's
inner buccaneer as it flaps
in the briny wind.

name: Felyne Seregios Helm α
description:
A helmet made from Seregios
parts. The gleaming blades
promise victory.

name: Felyne Seregios Mail α
description:
Armor made from Seregios parts.
Said to have been worn by
an ancient army, its unsullied
gleam attests to their victories.

name: Felyne Gog Burden α
description:
The misery of a maiden who
wakes in the abyss. The dark
holds only a cold smile.

name: Felyne Gog Prison α
description:
A miserable soul trapped in
the darkness, waiting an
eternity to be bidden awake.

name: Felyne Dau Helm γ
description:
Head armor made from special
Rey Dau materials. The azure sun
is proof of its innate power.

name: Felyne Dau Armor γ
description:
Body armor made from special
Rey Dau materials. The azure
features are proof of its innate
majesty.

name: Felyne Duna Mask γ
description:
Head armor made from
special Uth Duna materials.
The vibrant mask is proof
of its innate majesty.

name: Felyne Duna Cape γ
description:
Body armor made from
special Uth Duna materials.
The vibrant features are
proof of its innate valor.

name: Felyne Udra Head γ
description:
Head armor made from special
Nu Udra materials. Its writhing
scarlet membrane is proof of
its majesty.

name: Felyne Udra Tentacles γ
description:
Body armor made from special
Nu Udra materials. Its writhing
scarlet torso is proof of its
innate power.

name: Felyne Dahaad Corona γ
description:
Head armor made from special
Jin Dahaad materials.
The shining white crown is
proof of its innate majesty.

name: Felyne Dahaad Gown γ
description:
Body armor made from
special Jin Dahaad materials.
The shining white gown is
proof of its innate fortitude.

name: F Papier-Mâché Head α
description:
Blossomdance Ticket headgear.
The swaying of its whiskers in
the spring breeze brings a smile
to one's face.

name: F Papier-Mâché Body α
description:
Blossomdance Ticket body armor.
Skillfully crafted and painted,
this work of art embodies the
spirit of spring.

name: F Butterfly Hat α
description:
Blossom Ticket headgear.
The antenna-like accessories
resemble those of a butterfly
on a warm spring day.

name: F Butterfly Vest α
description:
Blossom Ticket body armor.
The large wings flutter
delicately in the spring breeze.

name: Felyne Afi Firemane α
description:
Flamefete Ticket headgear.
Blessed by fire, this mane
emits flames that protects its
wearer against evil.

name: Felyne Afi Firepelt α
description:
Flamefete Ticket body armor.
The flames that wreathe the
wearer seem to burn brighter
through the power of dance.

name: Felyne Aloha Straw Hat α
description:
Diving Ticket headgear.
Any Palico that dons this
hat will be the coolest
cat under the sun.

name: Felyne Aloha Shirt α
description:
Diving Ticket body armor.
This shirt's blooming floral
pattern will have your
Palico ready for vacation.

name: Meowrionette Head α
description:
Dreamspell Ticket headgear.
Makes the wearer feel as if
they're being manipulated by
something.

name: Meowrionette Body α
description:
Dreamspell Ticket body armor.
Makes one wonder whether
free will truly exists or not.

name: Felyne Meowloween Mask α
description:
Harvest Ticket headgear. The
spooky lighting is almost too
bright for the wearer to bear.

name: Felyne Ghost Garb α
description:
Harvest Ticket body armor. This
spooky costume is sure to give
everyone a fun fright!

name: Felyne Snowcat Head α
description:
Orion Ticket headgear. The
fluffy cap and scarf stave
off the coldest winter winds.

name: Felyne Snowcat Suit α
description:
Orion Ticket body armor
modeled after a winterland
denizen. Despite how it
looks, it's toasty inside!

name: Our Lil' Seikret Head α
description:
Lumenhymn Ticket headgear.
The snuggly result of loving
Seikret chicks way too dang
much.

name: Our Lil' Seikret Body α
description:
Lumenhymn Ticket body armor.
It perfectly replicates the soft
down of a Seikret chick.

name: Blanka-Chan Head α
description:
A costume of a mysterious
sprite (?) from a certain
jungle.
<COLOR preset="I_YELLOW">(Full Armor Set)</COLOR>

name: Blanka-Chan Body α
description:
A costume of a mysterious
sprite (?) said to appear in
a certain jungle.
<COLOR preset="I_YELLOW">(Full Armor Set)</COLOR>

name: Morbol Seedling Head α
description:
Armor that transforms one into
a Morbol Seedling. Its breath has
a peculiar smell.
<COLOR preset="I_YELLOW">(Full Armor Set)</COLOR>

name: Morbol Seedling Body α
description:
Armor that transforms one into
a Morbol Seedling. The wriggling
vines are delightful.
<COLOR preset="I_YELLOW">(Full Armor Set)</COLOR>

name: Wacky Wudwud Mask α
description:
A convincing Wudwud costume.
"You us! Look good! Just like!
Happy happy!"
<COLOR preset="I_YELLOW">(Full Armor Set)</COLOR>

name: Wacky Wudwud Body α
description:
A convincing Wudwud costume.
"Soft fuzzy! Furry warm!"
<COLOR preset="I_YELLOW">(Full Armor Set)</COLOR>

name: Felyne Bell Collar α
description:
A protective collar with a cat-
shaped bell. Give it to your furry
friend to show you care...where
they are at all times.

name: Thief's Thievin' Scarf α
description:
When Felyne's break bad, this is
what they wear. Don't blame
anyone but yourself if people
start hiding their coin purses.

name: Thief's Secret Pouch α
description:
A tried-and-true Felyne pouch:
easy to use, and just as easy
to drop when they hightail it.
